fact: The Ethiopian Meteorological Institute's satellite imagery page publishes Meteosat SEVIRI products including precipitation rate, dust RGB and a nowcasting product for rapidly developing thunderstorms.
The Ethiopian Meteorological Institute's page carries a Rapidly Developing Thunderstorms convection warning product for nowcasting, produced with NWC-SAF software.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Ethiopia among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
